obfuscation_indicators: no assurance payment rates will be adequate
risk_summary: The excerpt provides useful quantitative detail on revenue, gross profit, segment performance, acquisitions, and impairment charges, but highlights material reimbursement uncertainty affecting Therapy revenue and profitability. Goodwill and long-lived asset impairment charges, dependence on government and private payer policies, and reliance on management estimates indicate elevated operating and accounting risk. The disclosure is technically detailed but contains optimistic forward-looking language and limited quantified discussion of the reimbursement scenario's longer-term impact.
